distance_semantics: shortest number of basis applications from input to any output equal to the recorded one under TypedList.__eq__

filters.constant_output_definition: fewer than two distinct output items
filters.effective_identity_definition: transition whose item values compare equal to its parent's, so only the declared item type changed

generator_description: Complete breadth-first expansion from each root; a state first reached at depth k is certified at distance k. One sampled frontier layer certifies distance k+1 against the complete depth-k set. Expansion separates states no basis function may confuse, but distance is read after collapsing them onto answer equality, so a certified distance is the fewest steps to any output a solver is graded correct for.

strata.builtins.bytearray: empty, ASCII, non-ASCII and random binary
strata.builtins.bytes: empty, ASCII case/space/digits, non-ASCII and random binary
strata.builtins.complex: zero, axes, four quadrants and random components
strata.builtins.dict: empty, unique values, duplicate values, varied key/value counts
strata.builtins.float: negative, zero, fractional, integer, log/exp boundaries, random
strata.builtins.int: negative, zero, parity, powers of two, clip boundaries, wide random
strata.builtins.list: empty, singleton, duplicates, signed and fractional numeric values
strata.builtins.range: empty, singleton, negative endpoints, positive/negative steps
strata.builtins.set: empty, singleton, signed and varied-size integer sets
strata.builtins.str: empty, whitespace, case, title, numeric, alphanumeric, palindrome, a-prefix, z-suffix, multiword, punctuation, unicode, randomized templates
strata.builtins.tuple: empty, singleton, repeated and multiple None values

split_policy: by root: every task from one root shares that root's split
